interface.signature: def addBinary(self, A: str, B: str) -> str

preconditions.description: Both A and B must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A) and all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both A and B must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The lengths of A and B must be between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be the binary representation of the sum of A and B.
The output must not have leading zeros unless it is '0'.
